current_behavior: Canonical campaign/findings/diagnostics endpoints are exposed without route-level authentication or role dependencies.
recommended_change: Add `Depends(get_current_user)` and role-gated `require_roles(...)` on mutation routes; explicitly define read-only access policy for diagnostics/listing routes.
rationale: Sensitive orchestration and review/export actions must not be anonymous.
risk_if_unchanged: Unauthorized campaign control, ingestion, approval decisions, review decisions, and export staging.
resolution_notes: Added authenticated-by-default dependencies for canonical /api/v1 campaign/findings/diagnostics routers and role-gated mutation endpoints (operator/analyst/admin).

current_behavior: Tools API allows execution/approval/orchestration endpoints without authenticated principal enforcement.
recommended_change: Require authenticated user for all execute/approve/reject/orchestrate endpoints and enforce role policy.
rationale: Tool invocation and approval represent security-sensitive operations.
risk_if_unchanged: Abuse of execution endpoints and weak accountability.
resolution_notes: Added role-gated auth dependencies for tools execute/execute-async/orchestrate and analyst/admin gating for approve/reject operations.

current_behavior: User/program/certificate identity context is accepted from query params.
recommended_change: Derive `user_id` from auth principal and resolve program/certificate from server-side records or signed payloads.
rationale: Identity context should not be caller-forged at request boundary.
risk_if_unchanged: Identity spoofing and authorization ambiguity.
resolution_notes: Hardened tools execute paths to derive authoritative authorization context server-side from authenticated principal + guardrail certificate records. Caller-supplied program_id/certificate_id are now treated as hints only and rejected on conflicts; program_id is no longer accepted without certificate-derived authority. Authorization gate context builder no longer reads program_id/certificate_id from params payload.
regression_coverage_added: Spoofed program_id mismatch now returns 403 and cannot override certificate metadata

current_behavior: Key import/rotation/list operations are exposed without auth dependencies.
recommended_change: Apply router-level admin dependency, and emit audit logs on all key mutations.
rationale: Cryptographic key management endpoints require strict authorization.
risk_if_unchanged: Unauthorized key lifecycle manipulation.
resolution_notes: Applied router-level admin dependency on key management endpoints with audited access logging dependency.

current_behavior: Legacy finding status and tool-result ingest endpoints can mutate data without route auth checks.
recommended_change: Gate mutation endpoints with operator/analyst role dependencies; keep read-only compatibility paths explicit.
rationale: Status mutation paths are sensitive operational controls.
risk_if_unchanged: Unauthorized finding/run mutation.
resolution_notes: Added authenticated router dependency on legacy /findings routes and role-gated mutation endpoints for set_status and ingest/tool-result.

current_behavior: Path validation uses string prefix (`startswith`) instead of robust path containment logic.
recommended_change: Use `requested_path.relative_to(docs_root)` guard and reject on `ValueError`.
rationale: String-prefix checks are vulnerable to sibling-prefix confusion.
risk_if_unchanged: Potential path traversal/read outside intended docs root.
resolution_notes: Replaced docs path containment startswith check with Path.relative_to guard and explicit ValueError handling.

current_behavior: Collection path restriction uses `str(path).startswith(str(allowed_root))`.
recommended_change: Use `path.relative_to(allowed_root)` with exception handling.
rationale: Prefix checks can be bypassed by similarly prefixed absolute paths.
risk_if_unchanged: Read attempts outside artifact root can be misclassified as allowed.
resolution_notes: Replaced integration-hook artifact root startswith check with Path.relative_to containment validation.

current_behavior: Dynamic `/{tool_id}` route is declared before static routes (`/categories`, `/stats`, `/catalog/list`) and captures them.
recommended_change: Move static routes above dynamic parameterized routes.
rationale: FastAPI/Starlette route matching is order-sensitive.
risk_if_unchanged: Incorrect handler resolution and broken documented endpoints.
resolution_notes: Resolved route precedence collision by moving tool info/schema to /item paths and keeping legacy aliases declared after static endpoints.

current_behavior: Broad `except Exception` catches intentional `HTTPException` conflict/not-found responses and rethrows 500.
recommended_change: Add `except HTTPException: raise` before generic exception handler.
rationale: Preserves API contract and actionable status codes.
risk_if_unchanged: False 500s and poor client/operator behavior.
resolution_notes: Preserved HTTPException semantics in tools approve/reject handlers by re-raising HTTPException before generic exception handling.

current_behavior: Uses `reg.list()` but registry exposes `list_all()`.
recommended_change: Switch to `list_all()` and adjust iteration shape.
rationale: Current path is runtime-invalid.
risk_if_unchanged: Legacy approvals tools listing route fails.
resolution_notes: Updated legacy approvals tool listing to use registry.list_all() iteration shape.

current_behavior: `require_roles(["admin"])` passes a list instead of varargs.
recommended_change: Change to `require_roles("admin")`.
rationale: Current check is semantically incorrect and likely blocks valid admins.
risk_if_unchanged: Admin key import route behaves incorrectly.
resolution_notes: Fixed role dependency misuse by changing require_roles(["admin"]) to require_roles("admin").

current_behavior: Workflow templates are hardcoded in Python while docs describe YAML definitions as template source.
recommended_change: Either load YAML templates as canonical source or document code-defined templates as authoritative.
rationale: Dual definitions drift and mislead operators/contributors.
risk_if_unchanged: Documentation/runtime mismatch and accidental template divergence.

current_behavior: `concurrency_limit` is accepted but not used for execution scheduling.
recommended_change: Implement bounded parallelism or deprecate/remove exposed control.
rationale: API/CLI contract implies behavior not actually implemented.
risk_if_unchanged: Operator misunderstanding of execution performance controls.

current_behavior: Correlation record conversion is computed twice with identical inputs.
recommended_change: Compute once and reuse result list.
rationale: Reduces unnecessary work and clarifies flow.
risk_if_unchanged: Minor inefficiency and readability debt.

current_behavior: Canonical scope policy exists here, but legacy scope/resolver stack remains active in other execution paths.
recommended_change: Consolidate to one scope authority for canonical and tool execution paths.
rationale: Parallel policy engines produce divergent decisions.
risk_if_unchanged: Scope drift and inconsistent authorization outcomes.
resolution_notes: Consolidated authorization scope checks onto scope_guardrails evaluation path in authorization_gate and compatibility scope modules.

current_behavior: Legacy `policies.yaml` scope gate is deny-by-default and independent from canonical `scope_guardrails` policy.
recommended_change: Deprecate or bridge to canonical policy layer with explicit precedence.
rationale: Two independent models increase operational ambiguity.
risk_if_unchanged: Unexpected blocked/allowed behavior depending on route path.
resolution_notes: Bridged legacy scope.is_in_scope to canonical scope_guardrails policy evaluation to remove parallel policy decisions.

current_behavior: Dynamic scope resolution depends on file-based `workflow_store` state.
recommended_change: Resolve dynamic scope from canonical DB-backed campaign/workflow records.
rationale: File-based workflow state is parallel to canonical persistence.
risk_if_unchanged: Scope checks can diverge from canonical campaign execution state.
resolution_notes: Implemented DB-backed workflow scope resolution in scope_resolver by querying canonical workflow_runs -> campaign_runs -> scope_targets records and deriving runtime allow/deny policy overlays. Added async resolver path and wired async authorization gate support for workflow-aware checks.
regression_coverage_added: Workflow-specific scope checks are no longer static-only compatibility wrappers

current_behavior: File-backed hunt workflow lifecycle persists outside canonical DB orchestration layer.
recommended_change: Retain only as explicit legacy compatibility module or migrate to canonical entities.
rationale: Parallel engines increase cognitive and operational complexity.
risk_if_unchanged: Conflicting state and duplicated lifecycle semantics.

current_behavior: Single router mixes ingestion, detection, remediation simulation, evidence operations, and legacy run-store mutations.
recommended_change: Split into bounded-context routers and isolate compatibility endpoints.
rationale: Large mixed modules are hard to secure, reason about, and test.
risk_if_unchanged: Higher defect rate and policy inconsistency over time.

current_behavior: Global `KeyManager()` initialization can raise if `VAULT_TOKEN` is missing, causing app import/startup failure.
recommended_change: Lazy-initialize KeyManager in endpoint dependency and fail only on key-management endpoint invocation.
rationale: Optional integrations should not block full API boot.
risk_if_unchanged: Service boot failures in environments without Vault token preconfiguration.
resolution_notes: Removed eager global KeyManager instantiation; added lazy get_key_manager() and updated key import router to use lazy accessor.

current_behavior: Optional router import failures are swallowed with `pass` and no log signal.
recommended_change: Log warnings with module and exception detail; expose status in readiness diagnostics.
rationale: Operational visibility is required for dependable deployments.
risk_if_unchanged: Hidden degraded behavior and difficult incident triage.
resolution_notes: Added warning logging and readiness payload visibility for optional router import failures in main startup path.

current_behavior: Fallback DATABASE_URL includes static credentials.
recommended_change: Remove credentialed default and require explicit environment configuration.
rationale: Known default credentials are unsafe for real deployments.
risk_if_unchanged: Accidental insecure DB deployment.
resolution_notes: Removed credentialed DB default; DATABASE_URL is now required outside test mode, with explicit test-mode fallback URL and clearer driver error messaging.

current_behavior: Pending tool approvals/execution state are stored only in process memory.
recommended_change: Use canonical DB-backed execution/approval entities for tool API approval workflow.
rationale: In-memory state is not durable or multi-worker safe.
risk_if_unchanged: State loss on restart and cross-instance inconsistency.
resolution_notes: Reworked tool_execution_store to persist pending/completed/rejected records via canonical ToolExecution rows with test-mode fallback path only when DB driver/connectivity is unavailable.

current_behavior: Bootstrap installs latest tool versions and best-effort dependencies without pinning.
recommended_change: Pin tool versions and split required vs optional installs with verification gate.
rationale: Deterministic bootstrap is necessary for repeatable operations.
risk_if_unchanged: Drift and unpredictable bootstrap breakage.
resolution_notes: Pinned bootstrap Go tool install versions, split required vs optional verification, and added required-tool gate failure handling.

current_behavior: Legacy bootstrap mixes unpinned installs and package assumptions that are likely to fail in modern environments.
recommended_change: Deprecate this script or align it with `install/bootstrap_ubuntu_22_04.sh` and current catalog verification flow.
rationale: Two divergent bootstrap scripts increase maintenance burden.
risk_if_unchanged: Contributor confusion and setup failures.

current_behavior: CLI defaults to `http://localhost:8000` while backend docs/start commands use port `8080`.
recommended_change: Unify defaults via shared config or change CLI default to 8080.
rationale: Reduces first-run failures.
risk_if_unchanged: Confusing CLI connectivity errors.

current_behavior: README architecture/repo structure references `apps/frontend/` only.
recommended_change: Document canonical operator console path and relationship between `apps/frontend` and `apps/frontend-operator`.
rationale: Current frontend topology is ambiguous for contributors.
risk_if_unchanged: Onboarding confusion and wrong app targets.

current_behavior: Doc states YAML templates are definitions while runtime currently uses hardcoded template map.
recommended_change: Correct docs or switch runtime source to YAML.
rationale: Documentation should mirror actual behavior.
risk_if_unchanged: Incorrect extension assumptions by developers/operators.

current_behavior: Doc implies route-level auth enforcement consistency that is not present on several sensitive routers.
recommended_change: Document actual current exposure and remediation plan with explicit route groups.
rationale: Security documentation must be accurate and non-aspirational.
risk_if_unchanged: False confidence during deployment decisions.
resolution_notes: Updated security model documentation to reflect concrete authz coverage for campaign/findings/tools/key-management mutation surfaces.

current_behavior: Two overlapping developer guides (`developer_guide.md` and `development_guide.md`) are maintained in parallel.
recommended_change: Merge into one canonical developer guide and redirect references.
rationale: Avoid doc drift and contradictory setup instructions.
risk_if_unchanged: Contributor confusion and stale guidance.

current_behavior: Current tests pass (`272 passed, 1 skipped`) but do not sufficiently enforce unauthorized-access failure paths for canonical mutation routes.
recommended_change: Add authz matrix tests for canonical `/api/v1/campaigns`, `/api/v1/findings`, and `/api/v1/tools` mutation endpoints.
rationale: Prevents future accidental route exposure regressions.
risk_if_unchanged: Security regressions can ship while test suite remains green.
resolution_notes: Added authz regression tests covering unauthenticated access rejection across canonical campaign/findings/tools and legacy findings mutation surfaces.

current_behavior: No guard test ensures static `/api/v1/tools/*` routes are not captured by dynamic `/{tool_id}` path.
recommended_change: Add route-resolution tests for `/categories`, `/stats`, and `/catalog/list`.
rationale: Route-order regressions are easy to reintroduce without explicit tests.
risk_if_unchanged: API contract regressions can reappear silently.
resolution_notes: Added routing regression tests confirming static tools endpoints resolve correctly and are not shadowed by dynamic tool_id route aliases.

current_behavior: Optional LLM-backed tools were registered unconditionally, causing /api/v1/tools to fail when API keys or optional SDKs were unavailable.
recommended_change: Gracefully degrade optional tool registration and keep /api/v1/tools operational in minimal environments.
rationale: Core tool API availability must not depend on optional LLM integrations.
risk_if_unchanged: 422/500 failures for listing tools and downstream routing/auth regression failures.
resolution_notes: Added guarded optional-tool registration helper with warning logging and no startup failure on missing env/dependency; /api/v1/tools now returns safely when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or anthropic package is unavailable.
regression_coverage_added: Missing-key and missing-package paths now explicitly validated

current_behavior: Async DB engine used queue-pool settings universally, including sqlite+aiosqlite test runtimes where pooled behavior can block lifecycle calls under constrained execution.
recommended_change: Use sqlite-safe async engine configuration and deterministic lifecycle timeout coverage in tests.
rationale: ToolExecutionStore lifecycle must complete reliably in local/test runtime.
risk_if_unchanged: Intermittent hangs/timeouts in ToolExecutionStore.create_pending/get/mark_completed flow.
resolution_notes: Kept sqlite+aiosqlite on NullPool in hil_db and added test-mode DB operation timeout guards in ToolExecutionStore create/get/mark paths so lifecycle calls degrade to deterministic in-memory fallback instead of hanging when async sqlite connect stalls in minimal test runtimes; lifecycle test remains timeout-protected.
regression_coverage_added: ToolExecutionStore lifecycle is timeout-guarded and test-mode DB stalls now fall back without indefinite blocking.
